blocks.text: *Al-Burr* is the beneficent one. The absolute *al-Barr* is the One from whom comes every good deed and every beneficence. Man, however, is a doer of good in the measure that he keeps himself busy doing things, especially towards his parents, teacher and elders. it is said that Moses — may peace be upon him — on the occasion of his Lord's speaking with him, saw a man standing by the leg of the throne, and he was amazed at the grandeur of his position. Thus he asked, "O Lord, by what means did this man attain this place?" The Lord replied, "Verily, he is one who did not begrudge any of My servants that which I bestowed upon him, and he was (ever) dutiful to his parents." This is the way in which man does good. As for a detailed exposition of the goodness and beneficence of God Most High over against His creation, the explanation of it would be too lengthy. (But) there is some indication of this subject in some of the things already mentioned.
